div.p: CleonHR's Leave Management module gives you everything you need to define policies, process requests, track balances, and generate reports — all in one place. This wizard will walk you through the essentials.
Takes about 2 minutes · You can re-open this guide any time

t.p: Define every leave category your organisation offers — Annual Leave, Sick Leave, Maternity/Paternity, Compassionate, and any custom types. Each type carries its own entitlement, carry-over rules, accrual method, and approval workflow.

div.span: Click "Add Leave Type" on the Leave Types page to create your first policy.
Set entitlements (days per year) and whether days can be carried forward.
Choose an accrual method: Monthly, Pro-rated, or Full Allocation at year start.

t.p: Control how leave requests are reviewed and authorised. Choose between single-level (direct manager only) or multi-level approval chains. Configure escalation timers so requests are never left waiting.

div.span: Single-level: one approver (e.g., Direct Manager) signs off the request.
Multi-level chain approvers (Manager → HR → Director) for strict governance.
Set escalation timers — requests auto-escalate if not actioned within your chosen window.

t.p: Allocate leave balances to employees individually or in bulk. Adjust entitlements mid-cycle, carry forward unused days, and keep a full audit trail of every balance change. Employees see their live balances in real time.

div.span: Use "Bulk Allocate" to set balances for an entire department at once.
Individual overrides let you top-up or deduct a single employee's balance.
Export balance snapshots for payroll or compliance reporting at any time.

t.p: Link your regional public holiday schedule to the leave calendar so that national holidays are automatically excluded from leave counts. View who is out on any given day to manage team coverage proactively.

div.span: Choose your country & region in Settings → Calendar & Working Days.
Switch between Day, Week, Month, and Year calendar views.
Coverage alerts highlight days when a department is critically understaffed.

t.p: Once your leave types and balances are configured, employees can submit requests instantly. As an admin you'll review requests, check balance impacts, approve or reject with comments, and generate reports — all from one place.

div.span: Approve or reject requests with a single click; employees are notified immediately.
Use Reports to analyse leave trends, utilisation rates, and departmental coverage.
The Audit Log records every action for full compliance and accountability.
